channel.title: Atlassian Developer incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Atlassian Developer's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Forge developer installation requests failing intermittently [resolved]
item.description: We have identified the cause of the issue impacting installation requests and deployed a fix. The issue is now resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

item.title: Scheduled 5 min-triggers not firing for some Apps [resolved]
item.description:
On Aug 25th, 2026, between 08:12 UTC and 11:03 UTC, some Marketplace apps may have experienced scheduled triggers (5-minute intervals) not firing as expected.
The issue has now been resolved and the 5-minute scheduled triggers are operating normally for all customers.

item.title: Issues installing, uninstalling and managing Forge or OAuth 2.0 apps [resolved]
item.description: We have confirmed that the issues relating to installing, uninstalling and managing Forge and OAuth 2.0 apps should now be fully resolved.

item.title: Marketplace : Partner operations are down [resolved]
item.description: On Jul 13, 2026, partner operations may have experienced some service disruption. The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

item.title: Some customers received incorrect Time Tracker for Jira Cloud and DC app emails relating to free and trial subscriptions. [resolved]
item.description:
All customers that had previously received the incorrect notifications about the Time Tracker for Jira Cloud and DC app should have received corrective communications at this time.
We are now resolving this issue.

item.title: Remote Forge Apps facing rate-limiting issues [resolved]
item.description: On June 26, 2026, some customers may have experienced performance degradation with remote Forge apps facing rate-limiting issues. The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

item.title: Delays in processing incoming Emails, Work Item notifications, and Scheduled Triggers in Marketplace Apps [resolved]
item.description:
We are now confident that any of the tasks that were impacted by this incident and were delayed should now be operating as expected.
We apologize for any inconvenience that this issue may have caused.

item.title: Some macros failing to load in the Confluence Cloud editor [resolved]
item.description: Between 08:30 UTC and 13:51 UTC on 26 May 2026, some users were unable to load or edit certain macros in the Confluence Cloud page editor. Our engineering team identified and resolved the underlying issue, and macro functionality has been fully restored.

item.title: Forge custom fields are not getting created [resolved]
item.description:
The root cause has been identified and a fix has been applied.
Full service restoration has been completed.

item.title: Incorrect Banner appeared on MarketPlace Apps [resolved]
item.description:
Due to an incorrect deployment, a banner stating 'This app may stop working soon' was briefly displayed on the Marketplace Apps. This banner was not intended to appear on these apps.
The feature has since been corrected and the banner is no longer appearing. No action is required, the banner was displayed in error and there is no impact to app functionality or availability.
We apologise for any confusion this may have caused.

item.title: Disrupted Service Desk availability [resolved]
item.description: On May 14, 2026, Developer and Marketplace service desks were inaccessible for affected users. The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

item.title: Users experiencing issues accessing multiple Atlassian products [resolved]
item.description: All products and services impacted by this incident should now be fully recovered, and this incident is resolved.

item.title: Degraded performance of forge invocations [resolved]
item.description: On May 12, 2026, some users in US East region may have experienced intermittent failures with forge invocations for some applications. The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

item.title: Delay in Jira Webhook Delivery [resolved]
item.description: On May 12, 2026, some users in EU West region may have experienced delayed or queued webhook events. The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

item.title: Delays in Jira Webhook delivery [resolved]
item.description: On May 11, 2026, users in EU West and US East regions may have experienced performance degradation with delayed or queued webhook events. The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

item.title: Multiple Atlassian services are experiencing issues [postmortem]
item.description:
All dates and times below are in UTC unless stated otherwise.
### Summary
On May 8, 2026 between 00:22 and 06:08, one of our hosting providers suffered a significant incident in a specific availability zone in prod-east which led to Atlassian customers experiencing degraded performance and delays of background operations and automation execution.
The incident started on May 8, 2026 at 00:22 and was detected within 4 minutes by automated monitoring systems. Our teams worked to restore core access by 06:08. Final cleanup of backlogged processes and minor issues progressed in stages from there was completed iteratively by 19:15.

item.title: Degraded performance of Forge trigger [resolved]
item.description: On Tuesday, May 5, 2026, some Forge users may have experienced performance delays in webhook delivery in the US East region. The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

item.title: Delays in Jira webhook delivery [resolved]
item.description: The issue causing intermittent delays in our webhook delivery has been resolved. A fix was deployed to address a resource constraint in our systems. Our monitoring shows webhook delivery is now operating normally.

item.title: Degraded performance of Forge trigger [resolved]
item.description: The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

item.title: Some Forge apps experiencing increased Jira API rate limiting errors (429) [resolved]
item.description: The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

item.title: Missing Marketplace transaction data in partner reports since April, 10 2026 [resolved]
item.description: The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

item.title: Read/Write logs for Forge Apps down [resolved]
item.description:
The outage affecting Forge app logs between 05:00 UTC and 07:00 UTC on 8 April 2026 has been resolved, and systems are now stable.
We are currently working on recovery efforts, including retrieving logs from this downtime window and validating data completeness. During this process, you may temporarily see duplicate log entries; however, this will not result in duplicate usage or additional costs.
We will continue to monitor the system closely and provide further updates as needed.

item.title: Disrupted Forge availability [resolved]
item.description: On April 2, 2026, affected users may have experienced some service disruption. The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

item.title: Connect Apps Performance Degradation [resolved]
item.description: On March 24, 2026, between 04:14 AM UTC and 08:40 AM UTC, Connect Apps using connect API's experienced performance degradation. The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

item.title: Incident impacting Forge app installations and Dev console [resolved]
item.description: On March 17th, 2026, between 9:05 AM UTC and 11:10 AM UTC, Forge app management and related developer tooling experienced some service disruption. The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for affected customers.

item.title: Static macro rendering is failing in Confluence Cloud [resolved]
item.description: On March 12, 2026, affected Confluence Cloud users may have experienced some service disruption. The issue has now been resolved, and the service is operating normally for all affected customers.

item.title: Inaccurate install counts for some Marketplace apps on Marketplace [resolved]
item.description:
We are providing a further update regarding the install count discrepancy that some partners may have observed for some apps since Feb 27, 2026.
- The Active Installations tab in the Marketplace Partner Portal is now showing accurate install counts for impacted apps from Mar 3, 2026 onward. - The install counts displayed on app listings remain accurate for impacted apps. - Please note that data from Mar 3, 2026 onward will remain accurate going forward. - You may notice a temporary dip in install counts for Mar 2, 2026. We are backfilling the data, and counts for that date will be restored once complete. - Actual customer installs were not impacted; only the reported counts displayed in the Partner Portal and on app listings were affected for some apps, and this is now fully functional.

item.title: Forge billing subscriptions cancelled for some apps [resolved]
item.description: We have now reactivated all subscriptions that were previously cancelled. Impacted users may have received email notifications confirming this change. There has been no impact to the functioning of the app, it should continue to work as expected. To help prevent any future interruptions, we kindly request that billing admins ensure a valid billing payment method is added before the next billing cycle. We apologise for any confusion and appreciate your understanding.

item.title: Increased error rates on Jira and Jira Service Management Ecosystem Apps [resolved]
item.description:
This issue is resolved. In our monitoring no other unexpected issues were seen.
For customers still experiencing errors, this may indicate a legitimate permission configuration issue on your side and should be investigated as usual.

item.title: Scheduled Triggers not working for Forge apps [resolved]
item.description:
Impact
We are currently experiencing an issue affecting the Forge platform, specifically related to scheduled triggers. Users may encounter instances where these triggers are not executing as anticipated, disrupting the normal operation of their Forge apps. This behavior began approximately at 2 AM UTC.
Current Status
Our engineering team identified the root cause and performed a rollback deployment to resolve the issue.
